changelog: Admin: show all points of a job in-game and move them; purple admin markers only visible in debug mode.
Multiplayer crew system: invite, shared map blips and nearby crew payout bonus.
Level-based acceleration/top speed boost for job vehicles, trains and metro.
Train/metro: other drivers trains are locally invisible and non-colliding.
Car wash: proper wheel camera distance and framing.
Trucker: fixed missing payout, locked contract board and docking validation; added step help.
Tow: broken-down vehicles now spawn reliably on the ground with fallback models.
Metal detector: polygon search zones drawn in-game.
Firefighter: left-click cannon water visual fixed; native extinguisher weapon given via inventory.
